I don’t have real‑time access to the current IPL fixture list, so I can’t tell you exactly which match is scheduled for “today” without knowing the date.  

**What you can do:**

| Option | How to get the info |
|--------|---------------------|
| **Official IPL website** | Visit [IPL.com](https://www.iplt20.com/) → “Schedule” tab. It shows the full fixture list with dates, times, venues, and TV/streaming details. |
| **ESPN Cricinfo** | Go to [Cricinfo’s IPL section](https://www.espncricinfo.com/series/ipl-2024-1298425) → “Fixtures” or “Schedule.” |
| **Sports apps** | Apps like Cricbuzz, ESPN, or the official IPL app provide push notifications for live scores and match schedules. |

If you let me know the exact date (e.g., “April 12, 2024”), I can give you the specific match that was scheduled for that day. Otherwise, checking one of the sources above will give you the most up‑to‑date information.
